modmenu.descriptionTranslation.borderles: Permits thee to play Minecraft within a borderless fullscreen window.
borderlessmc.options.fullscreenType.tool: Governeth which fullscreen manner is used when §oFullscreen§r is set to §oON§r within §oVideo Settings§r.
borderlessmc.options.borderlessFullscree: Governeth which fullscreen manner is used when §oFullscreen§r is set to §oBorderless§r within §oVideo Settings§r.
borderlessmc.options.useDelayedFullscree:
Determines whether entry into fullscreen be stayed until Minecraft hath fully loaded.

Enabling this may grant a smoother beginning and remedy rare troubles upon systems whose faulty drivers will not at once permit certain windows to enter fullscreen at a resolution unlike the customary one.
borderlessmc.options.useScaledFramebuffe:
Determines whether a full-resolution framebuffer be used upon platforms where screen coordinates may be scaled against pixel coordinates, such as §omacOS§r and §oWayland (Linux)§r.

Disabling this may bestow a notable gain in performance, though image quality pay the price.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocus.to: Determines whether the game shall pause of its own accord when its window loseth focus.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocusDur: When §oPause Upon Losing Focus§r is enabled, determines whether its effect shall likewise befall multiplayer sessions, wherein the game cannot truly be paused.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:w:
A windowed fullscreen manner whose performance and ease of use vary according to the platform.

Upon §lWindows§r, this is generally the finest manner in which to play, granting the boons of borderless fullscreen with little or no penalty to performance or latency; yet some may suffer vexatious blinking whenever the game window gaineth or loseth focus.

Upon §lother platforms§r, this manner may cause grievous loss of performance or troubles of use, such as thy system's dock remaining visible or appearing above the game.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:d:
Minecraft's customary exclusive fullscreen manner.

It granteth excellent performance with little latency, though at the cost of convenience: the game is minimized whenever its window loseth focus.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:h:
Minecraft's customary non-exclusive fullscreen manner.

'Tis a middle course betwixt exclusive and borderless fullscreen, chiefly for those who need not a truly borderless experience, yet desire overlays or depend upon IME and kindred arts.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.linux:borde:
The customary borderless fullscreen manner for Linux.

It granteth excellent performance with little latency and hath no known ill consequence.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.macos:borde:
The customary borderless fullscreen manner for macOS.

It granteth fair performance, though with somewhat greater latency than exclusive fullscreen, owing to the V-Sync imposed by the realm of the operating system upon all windowed applications.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.windows:win:
The true windowed fullscreen manner for Windows.

Unlike §ominecraft:windowed§r, it suffereth not the blinking malady, yet neither doth it possess that manner's performance boons.

Its latency exceedeth that of exclusive fullscreen because the operating system imposeth V-Sync upon windowed applications. At times Windows may also cast aside frames whilst attending to background labours it deemeth of greater import.
